title: A Parasite Makes Crickets Walk Into Water and Drown Themselves
subject: cricket

scenes.text: A cricket walks straight to a pond and jumps in. Nothing chased it.
For weeks, a horsehair worm has been growing inside it, until it fills most of the cricket's body.
The worm lives its adult life in water, but it can't get there alone.
So when the worm is ready, it changes the cricket's behavior, and the cricket goes looking for water.
The cricket jumps in. The worm leaves its body and swims off to breed, while the cricket drowns.
The cricket never chose the water. The worm did.

description:
A cricket walks to a pond and jumps in, and nothing chased it.
A horsehair worm grows inside it for weeks, then steers it to water so the worm can leave and breed.
Would you have guessed a worm could drive a cricket? Tell us below.
first_comment: Which would you rather meet: a zombie-ant fungus or a hairworm? Both take over the driver's seat.
